record_scope_reconstruction: Iraq-to-Jordan oil consignments on the Iraqi Trebil approach during the October 2023 protests. This is narrower than closure of all traffic at Trebil and does not locate the obstruction in Ramadi, where tankers returned for safety.

source_checks.finding: Report identifies oil tankers threatened near Trebil, distinguishes continuing ordinary cargo traffic, and reports the safety return to Ramadi. The exact protest roadblock location is not supplied.

Official Jordanian report states that the affected October tankers entered through Trebil, including the final 33; this is delivery completion, not proof of uninterrupted gate closure followed by a single reopening.
Logistics Cluster explicitly pairs Trebil on the Iraqi side with Al Karamah on the Jordanian side on the Baghdad–Ramadi road corridor.
